import t4
from planner import *
from fcflow import FlowGraph
seed=29
rnd=random.Random(seed)
n,links,caps,parts,rdem0=t4.gen(rnd)
period=rnd.choice([1,3,1000])
envelope={i:min(c,10**12) for i,c in enumerate(caps) if c>0}
cpl=[period*envelope.get(i,0) for i in range(len(links))]
cap={}
for lid,(u,v) in enumerate(links):
    if cpl[lid]>0:
        cap[(u,v)]=cap.get((u,v),0)+cpl[lid]; cap[(v,u)]=cap.get((v,u),0)+cpl[lid]
k=t4.max_multiplier(n,cap,parts,rdem0)
rdem={v:rdem0[v]*k for v in parts}
total=sum(rdem.values())
P=sorted(parts); pset=set(P)
pr=PathReserver(n,dict(cap),P,rdem,total)

        # find the blocking cut in the split graph
        g,lim,tau,inn=pr._split_graph(S,d)

        print('  residual maxflow',val)
